Migrants in Ceuta Allege Beatings Amid European Asylum Bid

Migrants in Ceuta, a Spanish enclave bordering Morocco, have alleged they were beaten as they sought to enter Europe. Some Moroccan migrants are reportedly refusing to leave Ceuta. The situation involves individuals seeking safety and a new life in Europe.
